news.description: Monday 9th November No noteworthy economic indicators Tuesday 10th November 08:30 ET US CPI for October The Consumer Price Index (CPI), published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, measures changes in the prices paid by consumers for goods and services. It is a key indicator of inflation and an important influence on Federal Reserve monetary policy. Markets will focus on monthly headline and core CPI, with core inflation excluding volatile food and energy prices. NOTE: No year-over-year figures
